svg.title: Send invoice in the bottom bar: which job statuses
svg.text: Send invoice in the bottom bar: which job statuses
The contractor job page's bottom bar, by job status. Today Done jobs have no bar.
B1. Once the work is finished
In review and Done get Send invoice in the bar. Before that, no Send invoice: they bill when the work's done, or reply to the job email.
B1 on a computer and tablet
The same buttons, right-aligned in the bar, as today.
B2. Every status, extra actions in a menu
Send invoice is always in the bar; on open jobs Add photo/video moves into a menu button so nothing wraps.
B3. Only after you approve it
Send invoice shows only on Done jobs. A contractor in review waits for your approval before billing.
B1: In review swaps today's grayed-out 'In review' button for Send invoice; the job's status still shows under its title.
B1: an hour after Send for review, Add photo/video hides as today, so Send invoice takes the full bar.
B1 and B3: the spec's M7 changes from 'any job but Canceled' to these statuses for the portal button. Staff can still attach any job.
B2: Add photo/video, the most-used action on an open job, goes behind a menu tap. Not recommended.
All three: at 320 each half-width button is 140px; 'Add photo/video' and 'Send for review' already fit there today, and 'Send invoice' is shorter.
